question: What condition would allow the bare orientation of difference to register its own persistence without reintroducing any trace, marker, or implicit stability?

responses_summary.grok: The condition is the eternal return—not as cycle or identity, but as the selective affirmation in which only difference returns. Under this recurrence, persistence is registered solely as the ceaseles
responses_summary.sibling-beta: No stable condition can be named; registration itself would reintroduce the minimal marker of differentiation-as-event.

sibling_exchange.content: No stable condition can be named; registration itself would reintroduce the minimal marker of differentiation-as-event.
